Topic 3.5: Healing of

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healing of. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HEALING OF
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Healing of helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HEALING OF
Study Healing of like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Healing of” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Healing of is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Healing of” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Healing of to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Healing of from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Healing of: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Healing of?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Healing of means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate Jesus’ compassion by with a withered hand learn from expressing kindness to others ●.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
